help.apiKeyJellyfin: Create one under Dashboard → API Keys.
help.apiKeyEmby: Create one under Settings → Advanced → API Keys.
help.plexToken: Your X-Plex-Token. The Plex support article "Finding an authentication token" explains how to find it.
help.apiKeyTdarr: Tdarr 3 turns sign-in on for new installs, so a key is usually needed there; Tdarr 2 needs one only with authentication on. Create one under Tools → API Keys.
